facts.fact: 食物将尽：最后一包盐饼；「我们需要食物」=唯一能摆出的停战；脚痛响进骨头、绷带上缘红热
答案在窗外：校长官邸隔着草坪；多年未进但员工备货；可带回食物、酒、绷带、止痛药
facts.anchor: the President’s House was just across the green
facts.verbatim: the President’s House was just across the green

facts.fact: 雪原暴露：这山上一切在冬天都饥饿；只有她在月光下移动——易捕的猎物
facts.anchor: Everything on this mountain hungered during the winter.
facts.verbatim: Everything on this mountain hungered during the winter.

facts.fact: 官邸地下室：窗扣松脱（从她住那儿起就那样）、跌到旧台球桌上；满是闲置家具与节令装饰的鬼
facts.anchor: It had been that way since I’d lived there.
facts.verbatim: It had been that way since I’d lived there.

facts.fact: 楼上：Danvers 全翻新；每眨眼见旧样（父母婚瓷银器、父亲待客的绝望笑、胸针与发油味的客人）
facts.anchor: in a blink, these phantoms were gone
facts.verbatim: in a blink, these phantoms were gone

facts.fact: 坏夜回忆：母亲收尽屋里枕头毯子（像找软物的破喜鹊）；父亲每夜趴她膝上哭「我一个人做不到」
facts.anchor: Lovey, I can’t do it alone. What will I do?
facts.verbatim: Lovey, I can’t do it alone. What will I do?

facts.fact: 她拨 Jonathan 曾给的号码；「是我。Celia」「我想你是对的」；他沉默后一叹「收拾好你自己，或者别再打来」；线断
facts.anchor: Celia, get your shit together, or don’t call.
facts.verbatim: Celia, get your shit together, or don’t call.

facts.fact: 四失（他/Harper/父母/你）；踢腿撞桌、灯落毯不碎；抓灯砸镜——碎、镜中饿兽般的自己
facts.anchor: a starved animal here to scavenge
facts.verbatim: a starved animal here to scavenge

facts.fact: 全家福前清醒：问题不是父母、永远不可能是你——是他：关校计划把她带到手稿、他开除 Harper
砸屋：书/相框/圣诞树/银器/盘子/玻璃柜；想掷中水晶吊灯
facts.anchor: I left a tornado’s path of twisted things in my wake.
facts.verbatim: I left a tornado’s path of twisted things in my wake.

facts.fact: 一只小冷手抓腕——是 Harriot（没穿外套、踏雪跟来）：「你走时水壶还烧着」「你在这干什么？」
facts.anchor: “Y-you left the kettle on,” she stammered.
facts.verbatim: “Y-you left the kettle on,” she stammered.

facts.fact: 她烧得厉害；Celia 把自己埋进她毛衣（闻起来像她和她也像我们）；吻她
facts.anchor: her sweater that smelled like her and me, like us
facts.verbatim: her sweater that smelled like her and me, like us
